from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class ShareRecord(BaseModel):
    """A specific share count extraction from a single document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company whose report is being parsed")
    shares_outstanding: str | None = Field(description="The total shares outstanding as written in the document (e.g. with commas)")
    as_of_date: str | None = Field(description="The date or period end associated with this share count")
    source_section: str | None = Field(description="Where in the document this figure was found (e.g. 'Balance Sheet', 'Cover Page')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    share_records: list[ShareRecord]
